definitions.gloss: to climb to the very top
definitions.explanation: To ascend all the way to the summit or peak of a physical location.

definitions.gloss: to rise to the highest position, to reach the pinnacle
definitions.explanation: To advance through ranks or stages to reach the very top of a career, organization, or field. The figurative sense is more common.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた。
examples.english: I climbed all the way to the top of the mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After climbing all the way up the stairs, I came out at the observation deck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{坂|さか}→坂：01415_saka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: At the top of the long slope I had climbed, there was a shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた。
examples.english: He rose to the position of company president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた。

examples.japanese: {下積|したづ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、ようやく⟦{頂点|ちょうてん}→頂点：05448_chouten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the athlete who finally reached the pinnacle after years of working from the bottom.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb combining ⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧ (to climb) with ⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ (to pack in, to push to the limit). The ⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ component adds the nuance of going all the way, leaving nothing further to ascend. The figurative sense (career advancement) is more frequent than the literal one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}める: to rise to the top
- ⟦{頂点|ちょうてん}→頂点：05448_chouten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}める: to reach the pinnacle
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}める: to rise to a seat of power
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}める: to rise to become president
